metric_definitions.alignment_model: rigid SE(2), scale locked 1.0; transform selected by proxy metric on manual-region union (P05)
metric_definitions.components: connected components over road links + junction membership (union-find)
metric_definitions.connector_count: unique connectingRoad ids across junction <connection> elements (fallback: junction-attached roads) - canonical verify_final_xodr definition
metric_definitions.elevation_nonzero_count: count of road/elevationProfile/elevation elements with a != 0 or b != 0 (height-bearing profiles)
metric_definitions.dangling_road_links: roads with no predecessor or successor declared at all (any elementType)
metric_definitions.lanelink_defects: 1.0 for generated auto artifacts (recorded road lane-link valid rate 0.0), 0.0 for manual artifacts (recorded valid rate 1.0)
metric_definitions.drivable_lane_length_m: sum over laneSections of (section length * driving lanes present)
metric_definitions.connected_components: connected components over road links + junction membership (union-find)
metric_definitions.reachable_length_m: road length of the largest component
metric_definitions.unreachable_length_m: total road length minus largest component length
metric_definitions.junction_count: count of <junction> elements at root level
metric_definitions.lane_width_missing: lanes of requiring-width types without <width> child - canonical verify_final_xodr definition
metric_definitions.reachable_fraction_in_max_component: road-length share of the largest component
metric_definitions.road_count: count of <road> elements at root level
metric_definitions.road_link_reciprocity_defects: road link predecessor/successor pairs without reciprocal counterpart
